structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Placement of substance in Schedule V
law.text:
The Board shall place a substance in Schedule V if it finds that:
The substance has low potential for abuse relative to the controlled substances listed in Schedule IV;
The substance has currently accepted medical use in treatment in the United States; and
The substance has limited physical dependence or psychological dependence liability relative to the controlled substances listed in Schedule IV.
